server.name: io.github.Blahaj-gif/hitl-finance-mcp
server.description: Market data, SEC filings and risk tools for Webull, Saxo and IBKR. Only you can send an order.
server.title: Finance MCP

environmentVariables.description: Webull OpenAPI app key. Without it prices fall back to Yahoo and the account and order tools are unavailable; everything else still works.
environmentVariables.name: WEBULL_APP_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Webull OpenAPI app secret. Signs every request; the app key alone cannot authenticate.
environmentVariables.name: WEBULL_APP_SECRET

environmentVariables.description: Webull region: us, hk, jp, sg, th, my, uk, au, eu, br, mx, za.
environmentVariables.name: WEBULL_REGION_ID

environmentVariables.description: prod trades the real account. paper repoints the ENTIRE client at Webull's sandbox, quotes included, and needs separate sandbox credentials — production keys return 401 there.
environmentVariables.name: WEBULL_ENVIRONMENT

environmentVariables.description: Which broker adapter the account and order tools use, and where prices come from: webull, saxo or ibkr. Only the tools the configured broker can serve are registered, so the tool list never advertises one that would refuse. Webull is the only adapter that has been run against a live account; saxo and ibkr are written from published documentation and say so in every result they produce.
environmentVariables.name: FINANCE_BROKER

environmentVariables.description: Only for FINANCE_BROKER=saxo. A 24-hour simulation token comes from Saxo's Developer Portal with no approval process and no live money; live access needs the OAuth2 code flow. UNVERIFIED ADAPTER.
environmentVariables.name: SAXO_ACCESS_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: sim or live. Selects Saxo's simulation gateway or the live one.
environmentVariables.name: SAXO_ENVIRONMENT

environmentVariables.description: Only for FINANCE_BROKER=ibkr. This is the Client Portal Web API, not the TWS socket API: run IBKR's Client Portal Gateway and log in at https://localhost:5000 in a browser first. A paper account works and is the better choice. UNVERIFIED ADAPTER.
environmentVariables.name: IBKR_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to accept the Client Portal Gateway's self-signed certificate unverified, or point IBKR_CACERT at it instead. This is a decision about the connection carrying your orders, so it is never made for you.
environmentVariables.name: IBKR_TLS_INSECURE

environmentVariables.description: A descriptive User-Agent with a real contact address, e.g. 'Jane Doe (jane@example.com)'. The SEC's fair-access policy requires it and the filings tools refuse to send requests without one rather than risk an IP ban.
environmentVariables.name: SEC_USER_AGENT

environmentVariables.description: Optional. BLS allows 25 macro queries a day without a key; a free key raises it to 500 and extends history from 10 to 20 years.
environmentVariables.name: BLS_API_KEY

server.name: io.github.Blite-HQ/qnexus-mcp
server.description: MCP server for Quantinuum Nexus, wrapping the qnexus SDK. Not affiliated with Quantinuum.

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated toolsets: read,execute,manage,destructive (default: read).
environmentVariables.name: QNEXUS_MCP_TOOLSETS

environmentVariables.description: Permit credit-spending (HQC) execution (default: false).
environmentVariables.name: QNEXUS_MCP_ALLOW_SPEND

environmentVariables.description: Permit real-QPU targets (default: false).
environmentVariables.name: QNEXUS_MCP_ALLOW_HARDWARE

environmentVariables.description: Permit delete/cancel/archive tools (default: false).
environmentVariables.name: QNEXUS_MCP_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE

environmentVariables.description: Hard per-call HQC ceiling; 0 blocks all spend (default: 0).
environmentVariables.name: QNEXUS_MCP_MAX_CREDITS

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated project allowlist, enforced on every mutating tool (default: all projects).
environmentVariables.name: QNEXUS_MCP_PROJECTS
